youtube_title: Teeth Zing With Cold Water? You Might Be Brushing Wrong | Body Fix #40 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #40. Sip of cold water... and a ZAP through your teeth?
B is right. Soft brush, gentle strokes. Hard brushing wears enamel and gums.
With the inner tooth exposed, cold, hot and sweet hit the nerve sharply.
Fix: Soft brush, no sawing, sensitive toothpaste, fewer sour fizzy drinks.
Red flags: Lingering pain, pain on biting, swelling or a cracked tooth? See a DENTIST.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Sensitive teeth
